page.notes: The Greek phrase ἐν λιμῷ λοιμῷ is only partly legible on the scan and is marked [?]. The catchword "ternas" sits at the lower right below the last line. "Quin-etiam" is hyphenated at the line end, and "ex-" is hyphenated at the page end, so the next word continues on the following page. Spelling was normalised for u/v and i/j per the rules (e.g. vitiosis, vesci). The word "norunt" is read from a faint print and may be doubtful.
